question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**away**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank 3 will imply how some of the things are very distant from us.
 
• **In this context, the phrase "light years" indicate the distance between us and the objects in the galaxy.**
 
• **And since, the sentence suggests that something is not close.**
 
 
• **So the appropriate option would be "away".**
 
• "Away" means at a particular distance from a place. (एक स्‍थान से विशेष दूरी पर; दूर)
 
 
• Example: I tried to call her but she was standing far away from us.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Now" means at the present moment or time.(अब)
 
• "Between" describes the location that is in the middle of two things.(बीच में)
 
• "Close" means near or nearby.(बंद करना)
